_notes: Read from saves/Unmatched Official Tournament Table October 2026 (Hellboy).json (read only): infinite bag a959bb > bag 0c03c0. Every GUID comes from that inner bag and is kept when its objects are taken out.

fighters: by HeroDef fighter id (piece = GUID of the miniature or token; a list if the GUID changes when the state changes; dial = life dial; dial_max = MAX_VALUE of its script). Without a dial = 1 HP piece.

deck.card_ids = CardID range of the 30 cards; character_card_id goes inside the same physical deck (31 cards) but outside the range. deck.identity = (FaceURL, BackURL) of the sheet: what identifies the deck (the CardID is not enough).

intuition.note: Z rotation of an Intuition token for each face: inactive (dark) = 0, active (green with yellow stripes) = 180. CONFIRMED live on 6/11: the player turned the tokens to inactive by hand and they rest at rotZ 0. The tokens are found on the table by the nickname 'Intuition Token' (or GUID 5a17e9).
Another Uncanny Intuition token comes from the same object: takeObject for a bag, infinite bag or stack, clone for a single token. Confirm the object type with --read-only.
